subject: Proposal: compromise on termination notice / auto-renew mechanics
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@embercloud.com>, Shawn Patel <shawn@embercloud.com>
Cc: LegalOps <contracts@embercloud.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial redlines — MSA + Order Form (termination items highlighted)

Hi Olivia / Shawn —

Thanks for the productive call this morning. Per our discussion I'm attaching Redwood's redline of the MSA with a focused set of questions and suggested language around Term / Renewal / Termination-for-Convenience. Summary of the areas we flagged:

- Auto-renew: Redwood prefers a mutual auto-renew with an opt-out notice window rather than unconditional renewal; for pilots we'd like an opt-out carveout.
- Notice window: proposing 60 days notice for termination-for-convenience on the MSA, 30 days on short-term Order Forms (pilot scope) — see exceptions in §6.2.
- Transition assistance: request a 90-day transition SLA if termination is exercised (to ensure KV cache export and handover).
- Liability and credits: propose pro-rated refund for pre-paid dedicated capacity; no termination fee beyond pre-paid credits.

Request: please review EmberCloud's comments and let us know which items are deal-breakers vs negotiable. If possible, can your contracts team mark up the attached doc with track changes?

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_redline_v1.docx (MSA focused on term clauses)

Next steps: I'll loop legal and sales internally after your reply and propose an escalated sync if needed.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0129

From: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@embercloud.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Shawn Patel <shawn@embercloud.com>, LegalOps <contracts@embercloud.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial redlines — MSA + Order Form (termination items highlighted)

Camila —

Thanks for sending. EmberCloud legal reviewed the redline and attached our comments (EmberCloud_MSA_comments_v2.docx). High level reactions: we understand Redwood's operational concerns, but we have two asks up front:

1) Shorten the MSA mutual notice to 45 days rather than 60 to align with our procurement calendar.
2) Keep the auto-renew for hosted subscriptions (annual) but allow customers a single 30-day opt-out for pilots only — we cannot remove auto-renew entirely on subscription products.

On transition assistance, we can agree to support a handover but cannot commit to a blanket 90-day SLA across all tiers; we can commit to 60 days for enterprise tiers and 30 days for pilots.

We added inline comments where we think compromise language will work. Happy to jump on a 30-minute call next week to resolve the remaining redlines.

Best,
Olivia Hart
VP, Partnerships — EmberCloud
olivia.hart@embercloud.com | +1 206-555-9987

Attachment: EmberCloud_MSA_comments_v2.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:16:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: EmberCloud MSA redlines — internal readout

Camila — quick internal readout and recommended positions from Legal/Revenue Ops: (summarizing Ember's asks)

- Ember asks 45-day mutual notice vs our 60 days. Legal preference: keep 60 days for MSA-level termination-for-convenience but open to 45 for Order Forms tied to pilots or short-term engagements.
- Auto-renew: we should avoid removing auto-renew for hosted annual subscriptions; propose a hybrid: annual auto-renew remains, but Order Forms (pilots) get explicit opt-out language that triggers non-renewal.
- Transition assistance: flexible — accept Ember's split (60/30) only if Ember commits to documented runbook and an SLA credit for failure to meet handover milestones.
- Liability/credits: Redwood stands by pro-rated refunds for pre-paid dedicated capacity; Legal suggests precise cap language (e.g., refund up to unused pre-paid credits, not future lost profits).

Recommended next move: propose a compromise to Ember — 45 days mutual notice for Order Forms, 60 days for MSA termination; 90-day transition is a nice-to-have but convert to 60 days with contractual SLA credits; keep auto-renew for annual hosted products.

I'll draft suggested paragraph language for the MSA and the Order Form. Camila, if you want to offer any commercial concession (short-term credit to offset notice flexibility), coordinate with Marissa on discount levers.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: EmberCloud MSA redlines — commercial fallback options

Team —

Short version from GTM: we're willing to offer commercial concessions to bridge the notice/transition gap but need tight guardrails. Suggestions:

- Offer a one-time onboarding credit equal to 5% of first-year committed ARR if Ember accepts 60-day MSA notice OR accepts 45-day MSA notice + 90-day transition commitment.
- Alternatively, if Ember insists on our 60-day MSA but won't budge on transition SLA, we can accept 60/30 split but require a phased offboarding plan in the SOW and a holdback of the last monthly payment until handover milestones complete.

I'll prepare a short commercial fallback sheet (Redwood_counterproposal_v3.docx) that lists these permutations and the exact credit math for the deal. Camila — propose we present two options to Ember on the call: (A) 60-day MSA + 60-day transition + 5% onboarding credit; (B) 45-day Order Form notice for the pilot + 90-day transition + smaller credit (3%).

-Marissa
VP, Revenue — Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@embercloud.com>, Shawn Patel <shawn@embercloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, LegalOps <contracts@embercloud.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Follow-up: compromise proposal + next steps (DocuSign link)

Hi Olivia / Shawn —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for lining up comments. Based on internal alignment (legal + commercial) we can present the following compromise for EmberCloud to accept:

Option 1 (preferred for stability)
- MSA: 60-day mutual termination-for-convenience notice.
- Transition: 60-day documented handover for enterprise tiers; 30 days for pilots.
- Commercial: Redwood provides a one-time onboarding credit equal to 5% of first-year committed ARR if Ember accepts Option 1.

Option 2 (pilot-first compromise)
- MSA: 45-day mutual notice specifically for pilot Order Forms (MSA remains at 60 days for enterprise scope).
- Transition: 90-day transition for pilot scope to preserve continuity for pilot customers; 60 days for enterprise.
- Commercial: smaller 3% onboarding credit if Ember selects Option 2.

Ask: please let us know which option EmberCloud prefers by EOD Wednesday 26 May so we can prepare the final Order Form. If you prefer, we can sign Option 1 via the DocuSign link below; we will also attach a clean Order Form and the redline (Redwood_Accepted_Redline_v4.docx) for your contracts team.

DocuSign (Order Form): https://www.docusign.com/link/ABC-4721-orderform
HubSpot (deal): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4721

Attachments: Redwood_Accepted_Redline_v4.docx, Redwood_counterproposal_v3.docx

Next steps (owner):
- Ember to pick Option 1 or 2 and confirm by 26 May (Olivia).
- If Option 2 chosen, coordinate pilot SOW to outline 90-day transition milestones (Camila + Shawn).
- Karthik to bake agreed language into final MSA; Marissa to confirm credit calculation for the order form.

Thanks and talk soon —
Camila Reyes
